metadata.name: NonResettingLIFNeuron
metadata.author: Kobayashi, R.; Tsubo, Y.; Shinomoto, S.
metadata.description: Non-resetting MAT(1) neuron with one adaptive-threshold memory

dynamics.theta: theta * exp(-dt / tau_theta) + (alpha if max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt) <= 0.0 and (v + dt * (-v + resistance * I) / tau_m) >= omega + theta * exp(-dt / tau_theta) else 0.0)
dynamics.refractory_remaining: refractory_period if max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt) <= 0.0 and (v + dt * (-v + resistance * I) / tau_m) >= omega + theta * exp(-dt / tau_theta) else max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt)
dynamics.spike_flag: 1.0 if max(0.0, refractory_remaining - dt) <= 0.0 and (v + dt * (-v + resistance * I) / tau_m) >= omega + theta * exp(-dt / tau_theta) else 0.0

extensions.source_equations: Kobayashi, Tsubo, and Shinomoto 2009 Eqs. 1-3, DOI 10.3389/neuro.10.009.2009
extensions.discretisation: Forward Euler voltage at 0.001 ms; one exact exponential threshold history; sampled level detection
extensions.profile_note: Tau=50 ms is source-selected for MAT(1); alpha and omega defaults are a documented numerical specialization.
extensions.refractory_note: Voltage continues evolving during the 2 ms absolute refractory interval.
extensions.identity_note: SCNonResettingAdaptiveLIFNeuron separately retains the historical project recurrence.
